typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) = 1 	THEN \'MessageId,MessageDesc,LogDesc\' + CHAR(10) 	ELSE \'\' END 	+ ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(M.MessageId))),\'\') 	+ \',\' + \'"\' + ISNULL(REPLACE(M.MessageDesc,\'"\',\'""\'),\'\') + \'"\' 	+ \',\' + \'"\' + ISNULL(REPLACE(MRSL.LogDesc,\'"\',\'""\'),\'\') + \'"\' AS PrintLine FROM EPSDTMedRecordsStagingLog MRSL INNER JOIN EPSDTMessage M ON M.MessageId = MRSL.MessageId',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PrintLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PrintLine)) ~> FlatFileDestination
